author: codex

patch.value: Make every production TypeScript script part of exact coverage and add lint and duplication gates

The current exact coverage gate reports 100/100/100 for its configured source set but omits accept-native-toon.ts and accept-stat-cache.ts; the package also has no explicit ESLint or jscpd release gate. Add behavior-driven instrumentation for every production script, a meaningful statement/branch/function/line contract where the runner supports it, parser-aware lint for the mandatory TypeScript rules, and a fail-closed duplicate-code gate without artificial tests or exclusions.

Every source and production script is instrumented by the repository coverage command; every supported coverage dimension is exactly 100%; ESLint enforces no explicit any, no inline or dynamic imports, erasable syntax, and repository conventions; jscpd or an equivalently strict duplicate-code detector runs fail-closed; release:check and prepublishOnly include all gates; tests are behavioral and do not use coverage ignores, artificial execution, or broad exclusions
Inventory all shipped and operational TypeScript files, inspect current compiler and Node coverage capabilities, and select maintained lint and duplication tooling compatible with TypeScript 7
Makes the package's 100 percent claim literal across all production TypeScript
Prevents uninstrumented acceptance logic, duplicated implementation, and forbidden TypeScript constructs from bypassing release review
One reproducible mandatory quality gate covers all production sources without cheats
The pm 2026.8.7 compatibility audit proved configured coverage is exact but discovered two acceptance scripts and lint/duplication enforcement outside that gate
Inspect package.json coverageGate.sources and scripts; accept-native-toon.ts and accept-stat-cache.ts are absent, and no lint or duplicate-code script is defined
All production TypeScript and all mandatory quality policies are enforced by release:check
Configured sources pass exact 100/100/100, but two acceptance scripts are outside instrumentation and no explicit lint or duplicate-code gate exists
A release could currently satisfy configured coverage while regressions in operational acceptance scripts or duplicated/forbidden code remain undetected

message: Track exact all-source quality-gate gap discovered during pm 2026.8.7 audit
